scientific_scope: Descriptive saved whole-method P/F observations only; no quality decision

aggregation.field_missingness: Use only recorded finite values; report n per metric; never fill zero
aggregation.grouping_exclusions: Unconfirmed fixed contract/condition/RNG or contradictory saved plan/input metadata; not quality criteria
aggregation.recordings: Maximum six repeated conditions per recording; not independent recordings
aggregation.scenarios: Maximum five distinct recordings per fixed pitch/seed, equal recording weights
